info.name: Flowable REST Access Tokens History API

params.name: activityId
params.description: An id of the activity instance.

params.name: activityInstanceId
params.description: An id of the historic activity instance.

params.name: activityName
params.description: The name of the historic activity instance.

params.name: activityType
params.description: The element type of the historic activity instance.

params.name: executionId
params.description: The execution id of the historic activity instance.

params.name: finished
params.description: Indication if the historic activity instance is finished.

params.name: taskAssignee
params.description: The assignee of the historic activity instance.

params.name: processInstanceId
params.description: The process instance id of the historic activity instance.

params.name: processInstanceIds
params.description: The process instance ids of the historic activity instances.

params.name: processDefinitionId
params.description: The process definition id of the historic activity instance.

params.name: calledProcessInstanceIds
params.description: The lis of process instance ids that are called by historic activity instances

params.name: tenantId
params.description: Only return instances with the given tenantId.

params.name: tenantIdLike
params.description: Only return instances with a tenantId like the given value.

params.name: withoutTenantId
params.description: If true, only returns instances without a tenantId set. If false, the withoutTenantId parameter is ignored.

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the historic detail.

params.name: processInstanceId
params.description: The process instance id of the historic detail.

params.name: executionId
params.description: The execution id of the historic detail.

params.name: activityInstanceId
params.description: The activity instance id of the historic detail.

params.name: taskId
params.description: The task id of the historic detail.

params.name: selectOnlyFormProperties
params.description: Indication to only return form properties in the result.

params.name: selectOnlyVariableUpdates
params.description: Indication to only return variable updates in the result.

info.name: Get the binary data for a historic detail variable

items.docs: The response body contains the binary value of the variable. When the variable is of type binary, the content-type of the response is set to application/octet-stream, regardless of the content of the variable or the request accept-type header. In case of serializable, application/x-java-serialized-object is used as content-type.

info.name: Get the binary data for a historic task instance variable

items.docs: The response body contains the binary value of the variable. When the variable is of type binary, the content-type of the response is set to application/octet-stream, regardless of the content of the variable or the request accept-type header. In case of serializable, application/x-java-serialized-object is used as content-type.

params.name: processInstanceId
params.description: The process instance id of the historic variable instance.

params.name: taskId
params.description: The task id of the historic variable instance.

params.name: excludeTaskVariables
params.description: Indication to exclude the task variables from the result.

params.name: excludeLocalVariables
params.description: Indication to exclude local variables or not.

params.name: variableName
params.description: The variable name of the historic variable instance.

params.name: variableNameLike
params.description: The variable name using the like operator for the historic variable instance.

params.name: order
params.description: The sort order, either 'asc' or 'desc'. Defaults to 'asc'.

params.name: start
params.description: Index of the first row to fetch. Defaults to 0.

params.name: size
params.description: Number of rows to fetch, starting from start. Defaults to 10.

info.name: Get the binary data for a historic task instance variable

items.docs: The response body contains the binary value of the variable. When the variable is of type binary, the content-type of the response is set to application/octet-stream, regardless of the content of the variable or the request accept-type header. In case of serializable, application/x-java-serialized-object is used as content-type.

All supported JSON parameter fields allowed are exactly the same as the parameters found for getting a collection of historic task instances, but passed in as JSON-body arguments rather than URL-parameters to allow for more advanced querying and preventing errors with request-uri’s that are too long.

All supported JSON parameter fields allowed are exactly the same as the parameters found for getting a collection of historic process instances, but passed in as JSON-body arguments rather than URL-parameters to allow for more advanced querying and preventing errors with request-uri’s that are too long.

All supported JSON parameter fields allowed are exactly the same as the parameters found for getting a collection of historic process instances, but passed in as JSON-body arguments rather than URL-parameters to allow for more advanced querying and preventing errors with request-uri’s that are too long. On top of that, the query allows for filtering based on process variables. The variables property is a JSON-array containing objects with the format as described here.

All supported JSON parameter fields allowed are exactly the same as the parameters found for getting a collection of variable instances, but passed in as JSON-body arguments rather than URL-parameters to allow for more advanced querying and preventing errors with request-uri’s that are too long.
